_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Ni Mwina {player_id} mu Tic Tac Toe ya batatu.
Symbol yenu ni '{symbol}'.
Mwina alitasha symbol yake kwenye boli ya 5x5 kutenganya malo ya mina.
Malo inaweza kuwa na malo ya chalo, malo ya malo, au malo ya diagonal.
Tumai kubela kwenu kwa kutumia foma '[4]' kuandika seli 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ifya kusenda ififi. Belenga '[cell]' apo inselo yaba 0-{max_cell} .
invalid_move.out_of_range: Inambala ya nselo iyabula ukufikapo: {cell}. Ifwile ukuba pakati ka 0 na {max_cell} .

game_action.placed: Mwina {player_id} akwata symbol yake ({symbol}) mu filimu ({row}, {col}).
